_how: Newest first. The dashboard rolls through these, newest at the top. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD), where (phone | pc | both | web), title (one line, plain words), body (optional), link (a page on the site, optional), link_label (optional). Commit here — no Netlify build needed. Write it the way you'd say it to a seller, not a developer.
_the_title_is_all_she_sees: ON SCREEN THE DASHBOARD RENDERS ONLY: the Phone/PC pill, the TITLE, the link, and the date. It does NOT render body. And .wn-text is overflow:hidden with an ellipsis on a 1.5-line strip, so a long title is CUT OFF, not wrapped — keep titles under about 50 characters. Body is kept as our own record of what the entry was about; write one short sentence, not a paragraph. Only the newest few are shown (WN_MAX in dashboard.html), so an entry further down the list is invisible until newer ones push past it.

items.title: "Ilan na po?" — she asks, her card answers
items.body: When a buyer types ilan na po or magkano na ako, a tag appears on her mine card. Click it once you have told her and it goes.

items.title: "Pa 2nd mine po" — a backup sticker
items.body: One backup per ordinary mine, first come first served. It arrives in your pin queue and behaves like a pin.

items.title: Tagasulat 1.1.92 for Windows
items.body: For shops with long buyer lists: a buyer who read JOY on your phone but NEW on the PC now agrees on both, and the Do Not Ship address check reads your whole list. Update from inside the app.

items.title: Keep takes her off the board now
items.body: A kept buyer used to stay on the mine board until a restart, and she was counted in your End-Live summary and your CSV. Fixed, and she no longer comes back as a carry-over too.

items.title: The printer tries again, and 🔄 Reconnect
items.body: Picking your printer from the list now tries up to three times before giving up. And a new Reconnect button in Settings goes straight to your saved printer with no scan — try it before Find printer.

items.title: Type any price with the ₱… button
items.body: For the item that is not one of your four buttons. Per buyer, on the board and on the companion. Lock, Grab and Steal add nothing to it.

items.title: Her running total on every mine card
items.body: @bea · ₱247 on the handle line. The tiers above still say 49x2, 99x1 — the number underneath is what she actually owes.
